changes: Explicit user requests to re-diverge, switch or rewrite the locked direction are honoured in the same run (recorded with original words); the new sentence is independently checked and locked after user confirmation
Model-initiated re-divergence limit raised from 1 to 3; each round must record a substantive change of approach; stops for the user after 3
Concept-only handoff no longer crashes on a missing production manifest (KeyError fixed); production without a manifest still fails
Method cards that only supported the reasoning can be recorded as supporting with real candidate IDs; primary origin stays unique

Self-contradictory or contract-violating independent core returns can be registered invalid and replaced by a fresh blind review (original kept, max 2 per artwork, unfavourable verdicts cannot be voided)
Blind direction request states drawability covers retained directions only; extra rows for de-duplicated items are kept and ignored
Independent core return consistency: redundant fields are derived or spelled out with examples in the fixed request; a separate local-detail hint keeps a true answer; real contradictions stay invalid
A draft the user has finally rejected (bound to its SHA256) no longer needs a valid core return before the next draft; it can never pass or be delivered

Mid-run package upgrades are registered as an upgrade chain; bound earlier receipts are accepted as history and pixel/record checks are re-run under the new package; forged or off-chain receipts are rejected
Core review must compare product text with official assets for mirroring, inversion, typos and pseudo-characters as a hard check
legacy_regressions: Historical schema definitions preserved; 64 suites (3639 runs) and 209-stage pipeline pass
limits: Upgrading mid-run requires registering the upgrade chain; checks are re-run under the new version before delivery
Automatic checks are model judgments, not human approval
promotion_basis: Verified candidate runtime with documented distribution cleanup; publication only after explicit user authorization.
